list_child.name: lspermits
list_child.desc: Returns the complete set of building permit applications currently tracked by the permits office. This call is useful when staff need a full overview before narrowing in on any single filing.

get_child.name: getpermit
get_child.desc: Returns the full record for one building permit application identified by its id. Call this once you already know which specific filing you want to inspect in detail.

list_parent.name: lsappl
list_parent.desc: Returns every applicant account on file with the permits office, including both individuals and firms. This is typically used to browse filers before pulling up a particular applicant's history.

get_parent.name: getappl
get_parent.desc: Returns the full record for one applicant identified by their id. Use this when you need contact and history details for a specific filer.

delete_child.name: delpermit
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a building permit application from the system and cannot be reversed once it runs. This should only be used for filings that were entered in error or withdrawn entirely.

set_enum.name: setphase
set_enum.desc: Updates a building permit's phase to submitted, under review, approved, or denied depending on where it stands. This should be called whenever review status changes so the applicant-facing portal stays current.

set_bool.name: flagrev
set_bool.desc: Marks a building permit application as flagged for additional review by senior staff. This is used whenever something about the filing looks unusual and warrants a second look.

set_ref.name: moveappl
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a building permit application to a different applicant's account in the system. This is typically needed when a filing was originally logged under the wrong name.

send.name: callappl
send.desc: Places a note to call an applicant regarding one of their building permit applications, logged as an outbound contact. This is the standard channel for updates that need a more personal touch than an email.
